messages:
peter_sales: Quick alert  EMEA channel partner 'AtlasResell' is asking for a layered incentive to close a regulated telecom POC. Need deal-desk + finance + security input. @alisa_partnerships @marta_dealdesk

alisa_partnerships: what's the ask exactly? any deviation from the EU rate card?

peter_sales: summary: partner wants a 3-part commercial: (A) 30% customer discount for a 60d POC, (B) a 15% sell-through rebate on net revenue for 6 months if they hit a $150k ARR commit, and (C) a one-time "accelerator" bonus of k if conversion happens within 90 days. Standard EU channel discount is 20%. They also want to invoice monthly and request a SOC2 summary + signed DPA before POC.

marta_dealdesk: that's a few moving pieces. We need a quick margin delta and whether rebate vs margin is treated differently in our accounting. Please drop CRM opp id and expected POC spend.

peter_sales: CRM opp RDW-EMEA-8410. Customer potential ~$320k ARR. POC expected billed ~$48k. Here's a quick calc (rounded):

```
POC list: $48,000
30% discount -> customer pays $33,600
Partner commission (proposed): 20% on net -> $6,720
Accelerator bonus: $12,000 (one-time) if convert in 90d
Sell-through rebate: 15% on net post-conversion (6 months) -> assume $150k net -> rebate $22,500 spread over 6 months
Immediate net to Redwood (POC): $33,600 - 6,720 - 12,000 = $14,880
Baseline (20% discount): customer pays $38,400 -> partner commission 20% -> $7,680 -> net $30,720 -> delta on POC only ~ -$15,840
Total multi-month impact depends on conversion timing and rebate payout schedule.
```

kevin_finance: finance notes: accelerator bonus paid up-front vs upon conversion? If upfront, material cash out now; if upon conversion, we need measurable trigger and clawback for chargebacks. Sell-through rebates are treated as contra-revenue and should be modeled in RevOps. Also flag currency/VAT. Need RevOps to run sensitivity.

tia_ps: PS: POC requires ~50 hours of integration + a dedicated staging instance. We'll need SOC2 summary + DPA before any customer data. If accelerator covers PS, ok, otherwise request PS voucher. Also confirm whether partner-managed invoices impact our support SLAs.

security-bot: SOC2: we can share a high-level SOC2 summary and template DPA. Legal needs to sign DPA before any prod-like data access. Routing to security team.

marta_dealdesk: Opening ticket DD-10580 to capture approvals and attach docs. Please upload CRM opp, quick margin calc, proposed addendum (accelerator triggers + rebate schedule + clawback), SOC2 summary, and SOW. Link: https://redwood.company/dealdesk/DD-10580 :eyes:

peter_sales: uploading SOW + partner draft addendum to DD-10580 now. Quick note on cashflow: partner wants accelerator paid as a credit to their invoice (so reduces what they remit to us) rather than Redwood paying external cash. Finance, is that acceptable?

kevin_finance: invoice-credit is acceptable but needs explicit remittance language and monthly reconciliation. We will need AR contact and bank details in CRM. Also prefer accelerator to be applied after conversion and subject to verification; otherwise require escrow or holdback.

alisa_partnerships: I'm open to a limited concession if we get: 1) partner-signed addendum with concrete triggers and a 6-month clawback window, 2) SOC2 summary + DPA in place before POC start, 3) RevOps margin model + AR terms, 4) PS voucher/MDF alignment. Will coordinate partner signatures.

marta_dealdesk: conditions listed in DD-10580: - signed addendum with triggers, clawback, and rebate schedule - SOC2 summary + DPA uploaded - RevOps updated forecast + margin table - PS voucher or MDF applied to cover integration. If all met, deal-desk can approve a time-limited 30% POC discount + structured sell-through rebate and accelerator.

deal-bot: Ticket DD-10580 created  status: Open. Awaiting finance + legal + security.

peter_sales: I'll confirm with partner on invoice-credit flow and ask them to sign addendum prior to kickoff. Also will add expected conversion milestone docs to DD-10580. Thanks team :pray:
